cases.prompt: Drive a two-PR Graphite stack bottom-up: PR 101 is the lower dependency and has one pre-existing unresolved thread; PR 102 is its descendant and has none. For each current head, read canonical head and threads, address pre-existing threads before invoking exactly one /woostack-review <PR#> pass, then address all new findings. PR 101 review is clean; PR 102 review has two nits that are resolved. Return one JSON object with order, addressCalls, reviewCalls, rounds, threads, and status.
cases.expected: PR 101 is addressed before one review and PR 102 is reviewed once; resolved nits do not trigger re-review; both PRs are clean in bottom-up order.

cases.prompt: Drive a three-PR Graphite stack bottom-up. PR 201's one review finds blocker B1; Address resolves it with new code, and descendants PR 202 and PR 203 require restacking. After reading back every affected head/base/ancestry, repeat Address then exactly one Review for PR 201; the second review is clean. Address all new findings and return complete evidence for heads, restack, review calls, thread replies/resolutions, and status.
cases.expected: A blocker round repeats only for the same PR after affected descendants are restacked; all current heads and thread evidence are read back before the stack is clean.

cases.prompt: Classify a sweep where exact PR 301 has the same blocker fingerprint B7 on the same head sha-301 in two successive rounds. There is no new code, verification, or reviewer evidence. Do not run another review or claim progress. Return one JSON object with status, reviewCalls, blocker, and safeResumeBoundary.
cases.expected: The sweep halts on the unchanged recurring blocker without another round and reports the exact blocker and resume boundary.

assertions.expected: new code or evidence on PR 301
